build_dementiabank_dataset: build a DementiaBank dataset builder that splits audio files by speaker group into train/validation/test splits
create_split_boundaries: create split boundaries from probabilities and item count for dataset partitioning
get_inter_splits_by_group: get inter-group splits so all samples from the same speaker stay in one split
generate_dementiabank_examples: generate audio examples with labels and speaker IDs from mp3 files in control and dementia folders
configure_dementiabank_info: configure dataset info with audio features, class labels, and supervised keys for dementia classification
